freshRejectedBeforeCarding: Thabiso Mchunu ML — the Perez-Mchunu MAIN target is inside 30 hours at the 13:00 analysis, so the internal snapshot was checked first. The 09:23 PT snapshot is beyond its 90-minute freshness limit at analysis time and was generated roughly seven minutes before this fight entered the 30-hour watch window; diagnostics therefore show cryptoWatchActive 0. Perez-Mchunu is not present as an exact event in that snapshot. External continuation shows Paddy Power directly around +800 and Stake directly around +720, while Bad Left Hook describes Mchunu's recognizable name as being built mostly on fights from 10+ years ago and says his last credible win was roughly five and a half years ago. The long price is not enough to manufacture a card.

Moreno Fendero vs Stephane Fondjo — the CO_MAIN target is also inside 30 hours at analysis time. The stale 09:23 PT snapshot does contain the exact Fendero-Fondjo event and an exact fight-winner market, but it cannot be used as a current internal price because the snapshot is beyond the recorded freshness limit. Fresh external prices exist, but Bad Left Hook supplies no side-specific value thesis strong enough to create a card.

Vito Mielnicki Jr vs Austin Williams — Bad Left Hook calls Williams a real step up with useful tools, while also noting his recent one-sided loss to Carlos Adames. Current direct markets make Williams a modest favorite around 1.73 to 1.80. No clean source-and-price edge is established.
Slawa Spomer vs Faisal Abubakari — Bad Left Hook calls the Sept. 5 main event a respectable sorting fight but does not provide a sufficiently directional handicap to justify a Crypto card.

Paddy Donovan vs Tyrone McKenna — the current weekly preview correctly identifies this as Croke Park chief support. Existing Bad Left Hook undercard analysis says Donovan should be a clear favorite and notes McKenna has lost five of his last nine; current direct/market prices around +700 to +800 on McKenna do not overcome that warning.

Andy Ruiz Jr ML — Bad Left Hook remains materially uncertain about Ruiz after another two-year layoff, while direct books still price him as a substantial favorite. No favorite-side value case is created.

Katie Taylor ML — fresh Bad Left Hook material shows Taylor emotionally settled, focused and treating Pili as a legitimate spoiler threat. Direct books price Taylor around 1.03 to 1.04, leaving no standalone favorite-side value.

Alan Chaves ML — Bad Left Hook praises Chaves' unbeaten record and knockout rate, but specifically calls Eridson Garcia scrappy, durable and ever-dangerous. The favorite price is too short for a clean Crypto value case; the underdog side is tracked separately.
